confirmed_defects.description: capture-pane -p -L -e -J -S 0 -E 3 loses following text. At 80x24, print ESC[31m, 170 A bytes, ESC[0m, CRLF, NEXT. The pin returns all three numbered wrapped rows followed by row 3 NEXT; zz drops NEXT and splits the wrapped text incorrectly. number_capture sums ANSI-formatted byte lengths to infer row grouping (crates/zz-terminal/src/session.rs:8503-8523). Exact outputs: /tmp/zz-review-capture/oracle3/colourwrap-LeJ.{tmux,zz}.out. The existing corpus join case captures only alpha/alpha/beta/beta/gamma/gamma, and its history case returns only 0 alpha, so the claimed wrapped/negative-history coverage is vacuous. Final control confirms -e -J retains NEXT and adding -L loses it.
confirmed_defects.suggested_fix: Assign numbers using actual row boundaries rather than ANSI byte lengths, or retain an explicitly decided refusal if the required row facts are unavailable. Add an asserted coloured multirow wrap followed by NEXT, plus real negative-history and wrapped-row fixture cases and sabotages.

confirmed_defects.description: The newly accepted -C -e does not answer the pin's bytes on coloured or charset rows. For RED the pin emits literal \033[31mRED\033[39m, while zz emits \033[0m\033[38;5;1mRED\033[0m. For ESC(0qqqESC(B the pin emits \016qqq\017, while zz emits three UTF-8 box-drawing characters. Pin grid.c:1130-1138 explicitly handles escaped SO/SI; the worker's claim that history -C only doubles backslash and escapes ESC is incomplete. session.rs:8475; oracle3/charset-Ce and rich-Ce outputs.
confirmed_defects.suggested_fix: Cover nonempty -e attributes and charset controls in the asserted transport fixture, and satisfy the exact-byte clause or retain an explicitly authorized measured refusal; the plain-colourless -C -e case cannot prove this claim.
